verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents a headless mode for running without a UI under external API control, command-line macro execution (macro://), and batch conversion and printing. A community user confirms running it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates unattended, though another reports the macro automation developer experience is poor. It has no built-in way to schedule or trigger automations itself, so running them autonomously depends on external schedulers or clients. missing for 10: native scheduling/trigger-based automation, agent-oriented autonomous workflows, a smoother macro/automation developer experience.
